name: Tourauto
description: Lets tour authors choose whether their tour should open automatically.
project_description:
The Tour module provides users with guided tours of the site interface. Each tour consists of several tips that highlight elements of the user interface, guide the user through a workflow, or explain key concepts of the website.

 

 Back to top 

 Improvements from core 
 
 Integrated the Tour UI module to provide a visual interface for creating new and editing existing tours 
 Almost 4 times as many default Tours 
 Improved accessibility 
 Settings form to control the label of the button for starting a tour 
 The button block for starting a tour to allow to run tours without the toolbar 
 
 Disclaimer: Due to Tours being config and possible to be edited on a site basis we will not be doing any Tour or Tip updates retroactively.
